trigger: Any actively generating theory reaches the effective-time allowance without a newly accepted contract ID
action: Pause all bound experiment services, retain journals/requests/costs and persist a restart-inhibiting checkpoint
contract_identity: First accepted contract ID only; initial/inherited IDs, helper updates, proof-body variants and reacceptance never refresh the clock
clock_persistence: Theory clocks persist across observer restarts, retries and continuations; offline time does not count; an expired budget needs an explicit audited extension, never silent reset
known_exclusions: Provider builds, accepted-prefix replay and declaration prechecks, with matching preparation admission queues
Explicit stream reconnect waiting when no native callback is working
Confirmed session failure through next model turn, manual pause and offline time
included: Normal reasoning, retrieval, edits, helper work, candidate checking, ordinary RED and candidate timeout
Unknown silence before a confirmed failure
Observed concurrent model work during a preparation callback
binding_notice: Policy template only. Bind new observer paths, verified run/service identities and any audited carried clock before launch. Never overwrite frozen historical launch/config/checkpoint artifacts.
